biggest_catch: Both your account and the referred member's account must remain open and in good standing for at least 60 days before the $25 is paid.
catches: Existing members earn $25 for each new member referred.
Official page: 'There is no limit on the number of people you can refer.'
New member must open a new membership with a Checking Account via the New Member Referral Form.
$25 deposit paid after both accounts have been open and in good standing for a minimum of 60 days.
New members can earn $25–$75 themselves (up to $75 with $400/month direct deposit within 60 days).
Refer to the New Member Referral Form for complete details and qualifications.
